scripts.//playwright-path: Both commands below spell out ../../node_modules/.bin/playwright on purpose. Bare `playwright` resolves through this workspace's node_modules/.bin first, and @playwright/mcp (below) depends on a PRERELEASE `playwright` that npm installs right there — so bare invocations get a runner that disagrees with the root @playwright/test the specs import, which fails as 'Playwright Test did not expect test.describe() to be called here' and then 'No tests found'. For install:browsers it is worse than a failure: it would fetch a Chromium build for a version nothing runs. Root .bin/playwright is linked from @playwright/test itself, so runner and library always match.
